title: Leflunomide in Systemic Lupus Erythematosus
brief_summary: A pilot study to evaluate the efficacy and safety of leflunomide in SLE patients with active disease who are refractory to cyclophosphamide
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Fulfill the revised ACR criteria for SLE with either evidence of active disease according to SLE Disease Activity Index (SLEDAI)

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who are pregnant or nursing women, or those with life threatening disease
* The above information is not intended to contain all considerations relevant to a patient's potential participation in a clinical trial.
